title: What If You Could Hear Plants Scream?
description:
Scientists recorded plants making sounds. Thirsty tomato plants click dozens of times an hour, just too high for you to hear. So what if you could? Your houseplant asking for water, a whole street crackling in a heatwave, flowers that hear bees, plants that call wasps for backup... and a salad you'll never look at the same way.

Would you want to hear plants? Tell me in the comments 👇
